text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And this is where we'll place most of the decorations.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but I'll have to bow out now! I've got to attend a meeting with Trainer Kashimoto!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Okay, thanks for the help! Don't forget, I'll need you tomorrow. We don't have enough people to carry everything.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: I've got you covered! Carrying things makes for good training, so I'm cool with it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hm… We're good on the decorations, but I don't think one fridge can store all this food.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Shall I arrange for some cold-storage vans? If we only need a few, I can call them in right away.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wait, are you serious?! You're a lifesaver! I'll apply for parking space, so just let me know the vehicle models and whatnot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Understood. I'll make the call right away.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: We could do with some decorations here, actually… And we'll need to move the tables around for the buffet…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, Hishiama? I h-heard you plan to make the food all by yourself, so I, um…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that was the plan. It's a lot for one set of hands though… I'd appreciate it if you could help me out.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I bet ya everyone's gonna try and flood the dance floor… I should write a warning.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Me me me me! I'll write it! You can trust me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haha, I'll leave it in your hands then. Write, "Don't hog the dance floor!" Okay?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Don't hug the dance floor. Got it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Phew… Budget sheet and housekeeping announcements are good to go. Things are shapin' up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Looks like we're all in for another fun holiday!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Couldn't have done it without everyone being so eager to help out in between training sessions.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Watch out, Fuji! This year, Miho is gonna be the dorm of holiday cheer!
